data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (closing balance at 31 Dec 2015) is USD 23.463m. The report does not present a clearly labelled gross prior-year reserve movement (gross movement in prior year's provision) in the accessible notes or narrative; therefore no gross prior-year development amount could be extracted. Technical reserves and movements are presented in the technical provisions note but a definitive gross prior year movement figure was not identifiable from the available pages.
